---
title: "MRMhub"
subtitle: "An open, reproducible pipeline for targeted MRM mass spectrometry"
---

**MRMhub** is an open-source toolchain for **targeted Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM)**
mass spectrometry — the assay type used for quantitative lipidomics and metabolomics. It takes
data from raw instrument files to quality-controlled, quantitative results: peak integration, QC,
normalisation, drift and batch correction, calibration, and reporting.

It is intended for analytical scientists and biochemists who run targeted assays — the tutorials
require running R scripts rather than writing them — as well as for bioinformaticians who build
reproducible pipelines. MRMhub consists of two modules that can be used independently:

- **[INTEGRATOR ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/)** — stand-alone application
  for peak detection, picking, and integration.
- **[QUANT ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/)** — R package (`mrmhub`) for the
  post-processing pipeline. Accepts integrated peaks from INTEGRATOR or common vendor outputs.

::: {.callout-tip title="Getting started"}
Most analyses begin with integrated peak data — from INTEGRATOR, Agilent MassHunter, Skyline, or a
CSV export. In that case, install the **QUANT** R package and follow the five-minute first analysis
on the bundled dataset:

**→ [Install QUANT and run a first analysis ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/articles/tutorial-00-first-analysis.html)**

Analyses that begin from raw instrument files, and guidance on selecting a module, are covered under
**Choosing the right tool** below.
:::

## Choosing the right tool

For guidance on selecting a module, see
[INTEGRATOR vs QUANT ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/articles/manual-00-integrator-vs-quant.html).

| Available input | Modules | Starting point |
|---|---|---|
| Raw vendor files (`.raw`, `.d`, `.wiff`) and need integrated peaks | INTEGRATOR + QUANT | [INTEGRATOR Manual ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/) → [QUANT install ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/articles/manual-00-installation.html) |
| Integrated peaks already (MassHunter, Skyline, or mzTab/CSV) | QUANT only | [QUANT install ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/articles/manual-00-installation.html) |
| Only peak picking | INTEGRATOR only | [INTEGRATOR Manual ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/integrator/) |

## Why MRMhub?

- **Reproducible.** Every step is code — parameter files for INTEGRATOR, R scripts for QUANT.
- **Modular.** Each module replaces or augments existing pipeline components without lock-in.
- **MRM-specific.** Drift correction, batch correction (Broadhurst 2018), ISTD/calibration
  quantitation, isotope-interference correction, and the QC vocabulary (BQC, TQC, SBLK, ...)
  built into one container object. The terminology is defined in the
  [Key Concepts & Glossary ↗](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub/quant/articles/manual-00-key-concepts.html).
